description.value: Cusheon Lake Resort is the only lakeside resort on Cusheon Lake on Salt Spring Island, occupying four acres at the tip of a peninsula so every cabin faces directly onto the water. The resort offers a mix of one- and two-bedroom log cabins and cedar chalets, all with wood-burning fireplaces and fully equipped kitchens. A touring cyclist staying here would be 10 minutes by road from the town of Ganges, with complimentary canoes, kayaks, paddleboards, a barrel sauna, and two outdoor hot tubs on site.

address.value: 171 Natalie Lane, Salt Spring Island, B.C., Canada V8K 2C6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides rich detail about the resort's amenities. The FAQ explicitly lists 'dedicated high speed WiFi' and 'free level 2 EV charging' as included amenities, and the about page confirms proximity to Ganges town with restaurants and groceries. No mention of bike-specific storage, bike procedure knowledge, laundry, or bike wash appears anywhere on the site. The OSM phone (+1-250-537-4700) differs from the website's local phone (250-537-9629), which is flagged as a concern.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM has +1-250-537-4700 but the website lists the local number as 250-537-9629 (toll-free 1-866-899-0017). OSM number may be outdated.
OSM community field is listed as 'Duncan' but the property is on Salt Spring Island — incorrect community attribution.
Level 2 EV charging is listed as a complimentary inclusion (FAQ, truncated) but it is not clear whether e-bike charging via standard outlet is separately available or explicitly offered to cyclists.
No bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, wash, pump) are mentioned anywhere on the site; direct outreach recommended before listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The resort is clearly operational and well-suited to Salt Spring Island cycle-touring itineraries, but neither secure overnight bike storage nor staff bike procedure knowledge can be confirmed from the website — both required WWC criteria are unverifiable and should be confirmed directly with the property.
enrichment_extras.notes: The resort markets itself to families, couples, and groups seeking a nature retreat. Salt Spring Island is a popular cycle-touring destination; the resort could be a strong WWC candidate if bike storage and staff procedure can be confirmed.

Nearby evening food.detail: Website states the resort is 'only a 10-minute drive to the main town of Ganges, which has restaurants' — walking/cycling distance but town is close

Nearby grocery.detail: Website states Ganges (10-minute drive) has 'grocery stores, pharmacies, gas stations' and more
